<documents>
<document id="atm-cash-not-dispensed">
ATMˆdidn'tˆgiveˆmeˆmyˆcashˆIfˆanˆATMˆtookˆmoneyˆfromˆyourˆaccountˆbutˆdidn'tˆgiveˆyouˆtheˆcash,ˆorˆgaveˆyouˆlessˆthanˆyouˆaskedˆfor,ˆyouˆcanˆdisputeˆit.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆ1.ˆNoteˆtheˆATMˆlocation,ˆdateˆandˆtime,ˆandˆkeepˆanyˆreceipt.ˆ2.ˆCheckˆtheˆapp.ˆSometimesˆtheˆATMˆreversesˆtheˆwithdrawalˆonˆitsˆownˆwithinˆaˆfewˆdays,ˆandˆtheˆtransactionˆdisappearsˆorˆshowsˆaˆmatchingˆcredit.ˆ3.ˆIfˆit'sˆstillˆthereˆonceˆtheˆwithdrawalˆhasˆposted,ˆopenˆaˆdisputeˆinˆtheˆappˆwithinˆ60ˆdays.ˆTapˆtheˆtransaction,ˆthenˆGetˆhelp,ˆthenˆCashˆnotˆdispensed.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆnextˆWeˆaskˆtheˆATMˆoperatorˆforˆitsˆrecords.ˆMostˆATMˆcasesˆareˆresolvedˆwithinˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆIfˆtheˆrecordsˆshowˆtheˆcashˆwasn'tˆdispensed,ˆweˆcreditˆtheˆfullˆamount,ˆincludingˆanyˆATMˆfeeˆweˆchargedˆforˆthatˆwithdrawal.ˆ##ˆPendingˆwithdrawalsˆYouˆcan'tˆdisputeˆaˆwithdrawalˆwhileˆit'sˆstillˆpending.ˆWaitˆuntilˆitˆposts.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="fee-refunds">
AskingˆforˆaˆfeeˆrefundˆSupportˆcanˆrefundˆsomeˆfees.ˆThereˆareˆtwoˆkindsˆofˆrefund.ˆ##ˆFeesˆchargedˆinˆerrorˆIfˆweˆchargedˆaˆfeeˆyourˆplanˆdoesn'tˆhave,ˆorˆchargedˆtheˆsameˆfeeˆtwice,ˆweˆrefundˆit.ˆThere'sˆnoˆlimitˆonˆtheseˆrefundsˆandˆtheyˆdon'tˆcountˆtowardˆanythingˆelse.ˆ##ˆGoodwillˆrefundsˆOnceˆinˆanyˆrollingˆ12-monthˆperiod,ˆsupportˆcanˆrefundˆoneˆfeeˆofˆupˆtoˆ$25.00ˆasˆaˆcourtesy,ˆevenˆifˆitˆwasˆchargedˆcorrectly.ˆThatˆcoversˆATMˆfees,ˆforeignˆtransactionˆfees,ˆcardˆreplacementˆandˆexpeditedˆshippingˆfees,ˆwireˆfeesˆandˆcashˆdepositˆfees.ˆPlanˆfeesˆaren'tˆeligibleˆforˆgoodwillˆrefunds.ˆTheyˆhaveˆtheirˆownˆcooling-offˆruleˆinstead.ˆ##ˆWhatˆsupportˆcan'tˆdoˆSupportˆcan'tˆrefundˆaˆsecondˆfeeˆasˆgoodwillˆwithinˆ12ˆmonths,ˆcan'tˆrefundˆaˆsingleˆfeeˆaboveˆ$25.00ˆasˆgoodwill,ˆandˆcan'tˆmakeˆexceptionsˆtoˆtheseˆrules.ˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆaˆfeeˆwasˆchargedˆinˆerror,ˆtellˆusˆwhyˆandˆwe'llˆcheck.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆaskˆOpenˆtheˆfeeˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeed,ˆtapˆGetˆhelp,ˆandˆchooseˆQuestionˆaboutˆaˆfee.ˆRefundsˆshowˆupˆinˆyourˆbalanceˆrightˆaway.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="fees-schedule-premium-v2">
PremiumˆplanˆfeeˆscheduleˆHereˆisˆeveryˆfeeˆthatˆcanˆapplyˆtoˆaˆPremiumˆaccount,ˆeffectiveˆMarchˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆFeesˆareˆtakenˆfromˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆwhenˆthey'reˆchargedˆandˆshowˆupˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeedˆwithˆtheˆwordˆ"Fee".ˆ|ˆFeeˆ|ˆAmountˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆMonthlyˆfeeˆ|ˆ$15.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOut-of-networkˆATMˆwithdrawalˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆInternationalˆATMˆwithdrawalˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆForeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆ|ˆ0%ˆ|ˆ|ˆCardˆreplacementˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆExpeditedˆcardˆshippingˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆdomesticˆwireˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆIncomingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆCashˆdepositˆatˆaˆretailˆstoreˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ##ˆDetailsˆPremiumˆhasˆnoˆATMˆfeesˆfromˆus,ˆandˆweˆpayˆbackˆATMˆownerˆsurchargesˆupˆtoˆ$10.00ˆeachˆmonth.ˆNoˆplanˆhasˆoverdraftˆfees,ˆreturnedˆtransferˆfeesˆorˆinactivityˆfees.ˆTheˆmonthlyˆfeeˆisˆchargedˆonˆyourˆbillingˆdateˆandˆisn'tˆprorated.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
